Paired with documented Acrobat desktop page extraction. Processing depends on the selected connection mode and tool availability. Documentary editorial alternative only, not native output testing or full Acrobat parity.
claims.value: alternative

claims.name: No Subscription
claims.value: Yes

claims.name: Pricing Model
claims.value: The Free individual editor includes manual PDF tools on desktop, Web and self-hosted deployments. Paid team administration and metered automation are separate. This recommendation covers manual page organization, not AI or automated processing.

claims.name: Trade-Off Summary
claims.value: The Windows desktop app supports different connection modes. Built-in tools can run locally; tools marked with a cloud badge may require Cloud sign-in or a server. In Cloud mode manual tools do not use credits, while AI, processing folders and pipelines do. Verify the mode before processing sensitive files. Output fidelity and native Windows behavior have not been independently tested; no full Acrobat, offline or privacy guarantee.
